unknown_station_prior_exposure.DLA8: no prior scored station exposure identified

eligibility: valid coordinates, one station, all dropoffs have original nonempty zone labels; exclude all previously scored route IDs and station-days
selection: metadata-only SHA256 ranks; one route per date; training station pool uses previously exposed stations and excludes both held-out stations; unknown means unseen by this fitted model
automatic_zone_label_format: A-{spatial_leaf_index+1:02d}.1A; researcher adaptation, not observed operator zones
merge: author rule: choose path if its reported physical integer travel cost <= floor(1.01 * precedence cost), otherwise precedence; never choose using actual sequence
package_adapter: empty dictionaries at every stop, used only as ordered ID mapping; no invented package attributes; -Windows disabled as in author apply script
station_zone_serialization: the source Station zone NaN is serialized as null; dropoff labels are unchanged in public-zone variants
quality_labels: evaluation archive has no High/Medium/Low labels; no quality selection; do not claim official training-split reproduction
primary_metric: official Amazon score against withheld actual order, lower is better
repeats: repeat full public-zone inference once for first same-station and first unknown-station route; no tuning from repeats
acceptance: all routes retained, exact station-first permutation, independent official scorer agreement within 1e-10, zero train/test route or station leakage in unknown split; no operational equivalence margin or claim of Ota validity
actual_schema_inspection_before_registra: eval_actual.json was parsed once to inspect its first value keys only; no selected route order or score was inspected or used for selection
